name: octrow-skills
description: Agent skills by octrow for Claude Code and Claude Tag

plugins.name: repo-ready
plugins.description: Repo readiness: publish safely (security, README, EN/RU, SEO, CI, release), get deploy-ready (Docker, Compose, GHCR, Helm, one VPS), keep Python code healthy (ruff, complexity, dead code), and audit app security (authz, client trust, rate limits, secrets, backups).

plugins.name: python-logging
plugins.description: Logging for Python projects: a disk budget for all logs, size rotation, wide events (one JSON line per unit of work), secret redaction, journald-friendly records, and tests that prove the cap.

plugins.name: llm-call-audit
plugins.description: Audit LLM calls per call site: plain code, a Jev classifier or a cheaper model where quality holds, context cuts and gateway route fixes, backed by numbers from logs and the LLM cache.

plugins.name: logic-map
plugins.description: Logic map for agents: one file (docs/logic-map.md) that shows where the main flow splits, what each step decides, how it fails and which module does it, checked against the code by a test.

plugins.name: qt-ui
plugins.description: Visual fixes for PySide6 / PyQt6 desktop GUIs: screenshots of every screen in both themes, fixes through theme tokens that copy the neighbour screen, a before/after pixel diff.

plugins.name: qt-app
plugins.description: PySide6 desktop GUI from scratch for a Python project: the core on an asyncio thread with Qt signals, a sidebar window and an own token theme from a runnable template, screens test-first with pytest-qt and the same texts and calls as the CLI; pairs with qt-ui for layout polish.

plugins.name: system-design
plugins.description: System design from numbers: requirements, napkin math from a script (RPS, servers, cache, DB nodes, storage, egress), the smallest scaling rung that holds, storage and cache patterns by access pattern, failure plan and trade-offs; blank page or existing repo.

plugins.name: lean-spec
plugins.description: Check or speed up one piece of logic against a Lean 4 model: approved and frozen theorems, the model as an oracle for Hypothesis differential tests, a proved fast path with a runtime guard and fallback, or the rules of a logic-map step as the requirement; one gate (lake build, cheat grep, lake comparator, tests).

plugins.name: repo-scout
plugins.description: Find GitHub repos to build on before writing your own: search, triage, verdicts. Needs the repo-scout CLI.
